turns.question: On 1 and 2 October 2026, how much larger in EUR was the average amount of returns with reason damaged than of returns with reason wrong size?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-return metric, so I cannot give the averages; for 1 and 2 October 2026 the Returns (EUR) metric gives 12.5 EUR across 1 return for damaged goods and 5.0 EUR across 1 return for wrong size. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.
